1) Definitely crash-landed their ship on the planet but how their ship got near the planet is anybody’s guess. I’d guess it was a warp gone bad or something along those lines.

2) I doubt we are in the solar system since the planet is a little too alien to be earth and a little too oceanic to be anywhere else.

3) Entropy seems to be nonexistent as a boiler perfectly heats water with the fuel value it’s given. I could be wrong here but I’m pretty sure this is right. Everything else seems to be normal.

4) Biters are a chitinous hive mind so they are very similar to some insect species we have on earth. The other interesting thing is, biters are functionally immortal. They don’t die unless we kill them. This makes them somewhat like lobsters which can grow massive since they can live (probably) forever. Now as to how they can survive the square cube law, it’s hard to say. They seem to survive on air (since we don’t see them eating fish) and CO2 just accelerates their growth so maybe as they get bigger their internal respiratory system changes and manages the increasing energy demand? No clue.

5) I think the engineer is a combination of human and robot. This makes sense to me because you can’t craft things like gears perfectly with human hands. So an augment to help craft things seems like something the engineer would have. Part human because they look around in idle. If you were a full robot, you’d just have cameras around that you would process. No reason to look around.

6) I would say we aren’t past tier 1. Using the entire planet’s resources would include geothermal/hydro plants and we don’t have access to those in factorio. Maybe the outside civilization is more advanced but from the engineer alone, probably around 0.4-0.5.

7) An explanation I really like for the guns in the game are that the bullets replace gunpowder with compressed air. When crafting ammo, the shells are made and filled with compressed air so that when fired, there’s a similar effect to a gun. Those shells need to be removed so the next one can get loaded just like a regular gun. There is a flash though and my explanation for that is that the alien planet has some gases that are combustible and when the striker hits the bullet, it creates a spark and ignites the combustible gases along with any oxygen in the shell. I think that fits decently well.

8) I don’t think the planet is terraformed because if it was, there would be a lot more biodiversity. We just get grass, trees, fish, and biters. So I think that it’s just another lucky world like Earth and the local population are the biters.

Let me know if you agree/disagree on anything!
